sentences.text: Today, we will talk about Canada.
Let's learn some simple English together.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and you can repeat.
Canada is a big country.
It is very, very big.
Canada is in North America.
It is north of the United States.
Canada is the second biggest country in the world.
Only Russia is bigger.
Canada has 10 provinces and three territories.
A province is like a state.
Some provinces are big and some are small.
What is the capital city of Canada?
The capital city is Ottawa.
Ottawa is in the province of Ontario.
It is not the biggest city, but it is the capital city.
The government is in Ottawa.
The biggest city in Canada is Toronto.
Toronto is also in Ontario.
Many people live there.
Toronto is very busy and modern.
Another big city is Vancouver.
Vancouver is on the west coast.
It is in the province of British Columbia.
It has mountains, forests, and the ocean.
It is very beautiful.
In the east there is a city called Montreal.
Montreal is in the province of Quebec.
People speak French in Quebec.
So in Montreal you can hear both English and French.
What language do people speak in Canada?
Canada has two official languages.
English and French.
Most people speak English, but in some parts of Canada people speak French.
French is very common in Quebec.
In schools, many children learn both English and French.
How many people live in Canada?
About 40 million people live in Canada.
That is not a lot for such a big country.
Canada has many big cities.
But there are also many small towns.
And there is a lot of nature.
Let's talk about nature in Canada.
Canada has many beautiful places.
There are forests, mountains, rivers, and lakes.
Canada has more lakes than any other country in the world.
One famous place is the Rocky Mountains.
These mountains are big and beautiful.
People go there to hike, ski, and enjoy nature.
Another famous place is Niagara Falls.
It is a big and powerful waterfall.
Many people visit Niagara Falls every year.
In Canada, you can see animals like moose, bears, and beavers.
The beaver is a national symbol of Canada.
It is even on some Canadian coins.
What is the weather like in Canada?
In the winter, it is very cold.
There is a lot of snow.
In some places, it can be minor 30 degrees Celsius.
People wear warm clothes like jackets, hats, and boots.
In the winter, people like to ski, skate, and play hockey.
In the summer, it can be warm.
People go outside.
They go camping, swimming, and hiking.
The weather can be very nice in the summer.
Now let's talk about Canadian food.
Canada has many types of food.
People from many countries live in Canada.
So you can find food from all around the world.
But there are some foods that are special to Canada.
One famous Canadian food is poutine.
Poutine has French fries, cheese curds, and gravy.
It is warm, soft, and delicious.
Another Canadian food is maple syrup.
Maple syrup comes from maple trees.
In spring, people collect the sap from the tree.
Then they make sweet maple syrup.
People eat it on pancakes, waffles, and toast.
There is a maple leaf on the Canadian flag.
Let's learn some fun facts about Canada.
Canada is very safe.
It is a peaceful country.
People are friendly and polite.
Many people say sorry a lot.
The flag of Canada is red and white.
It has a big red maple leaf in the center.
The national animal is the beaver.
And the national sport is ice hockey.
Now you know many things about Canada.
You can say where it is.
You can name some cities.
You know what languages people speak.
You can talk about the food, the weather, and nature.
Well done.
I hope you enjoyed this episode of the Slow English Podcast.
Thank you for listening.
I am Emily, and I will see you next time.
Bye for now.
